column1: # Biological tRNA Per-Amino Acid Charging Status Comparisons
# This file defines charging status comparisons for each amino acid.
# Each comparison trains a model to discriminate charged vs uncharged
# status for a specific amino acid type.
# For each amino acid (e.g., Ala_charged_uncharged), the workflow will:
# 1. Merge all Ala_charged reads with label "charged"
# 2. Merge all Ala_uncharged reads with label "uncharged"
# 3. Train a binary classifier to discriminate charged vs uncharged
# This creates 20 charging status classifiers (one per amino acid)
